notes.title: Character Background #2 Veronica
notes.content:
[b]#2 Veronica[/b]

Hey, it’s me again! I’ve got some interesting bits for you, so that we can get to know each other better. Let me tell you where my love toward Pińczów came from. Most people don’t really think twice about their hometown. They either don’t feel anything particular about it or want to get away.

As for me, despite all the bad I’ve had to endure here, I can’t help being in love with Pińczów, its architecture, and historical sights. I love the fountain in the market square, the courts where you can spend some quality time, or St. Anne’s hill, with its view of the whole town.

I also have some precious memories in the nearby woods, where I used to play with my dad. He would often give me a piggyback so that I could reach the higher trees! I’ll never forget all the fun we had back then. Life… it was like a fairytale back then. And now? It’s all just a murky memory of good old days gone by…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45392518/134d47259a507bc509865931d132b9e27e46ff8b.png[/img]

notes.title: Character Background #1 Veronica
notes.content:
[b]#1 Veronica[/b]

Hi! My name’s Veronica. Let me tell you a bit about myself. I’m 18 and I attend Pińczów High. Talk about boring, right? Not a lot of interesting stuff happens there. I don’t have a lot of friends. Honestly, I don’t really talk to anyone much. 

Hell, even the teachers are constantly on my case for getting in trouble. Then there’s my annoying mom… but that’ll have to wait for another time. I spend most of my time playing video games or browsing the internet. I enjoy reading news on Pińczów. My town has a special place in my heart. It’s where I was born and raised.

I often stumble upon new, interesting places in the area and enjoy my time there. I love nature and animals. Other than having a few internet friends, I always expected I was doomed to be a loner. Still, change has a way of sneaking up on you when you least expect…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45392518/d224de07319cd58d3e4d127664765d6979a28eb3.png[/img]
